name: io.github.inotakeh/symbol
description: Read-only MCP server for the Symbol blockchain (XYM): node health, harvesting, voting keys.

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOL_NODE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Symbol REST node to query, e.g. https://your-node.example:3001

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOL_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone for local date/time output, e.g. Asia/Tokyo (default UTC)

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOL_REFERENCE_NODES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated REST URLs of reference nodes for symbol_network_compare (optional)
